title: Talent Acquisition Executive
description: We are seeking a dedicated and motivated Talent Acquisition Executive to join our HR team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent for our organization. As a Talent Acquisition Executive, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, ensuring a smooth and efficient hiring experience for both candidates and hiring managers. Key Responsibilities: - Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their staffing needs and develop effective recruitment strategies. - Source candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, and networking events. - Screen resumes and conduct initial interviews to assess candidates' qualifications and fit for the organization. - Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and candidates, ensuring timely communication throughout the process. - Maintain accurate records of candidate interactions and recruitment metrics to track progress and improve processes. - Assist in the development of job descriptions and recruitment materials to attract the right talent. - Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in talent acquisition to enhance recruitment efforts. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of HR practices and recruitment processes. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Proficiency in using recruitment software and tools. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. If you are passionate about connecting talent with opportunity and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as a Talent Acquisition Executive.This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Recruiter
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Job Description Preparation: Prepare clear and comprehensive job descriptions based on the hiring requirements and specifications shared by the concerned departments.
* Job Posting: Publish job openings across multiple job portals and recruitment platforms to attract suitable candidates.
* Candidate Sourcing: Source candidates through various job portals, professional networks, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Resume Screening: Review and shortlist resumes based on job requirements, qualifications, experience, and suitability for the role.
* HR Interviews: Conduct initial HR screening and interviews to assess candidates' communication skills, experience, career expectations, and overall suitability.
* Interview Coordination: Coordinate with hiring managers, department heads, and other stakeholders to schedule further rounds of interviews and obtain timely feedback.
* Salary Negotiation: Discuss current compensation, salary expectations, notice periods, and joining availability with candidates, ensuring alignment with the approved hiring budget.
* Offer Management: Coordinate the offer process, communicate offers to selected candidates, and follow up on offer acceptance and joining commitments.
* Onboarding Support: Assist with pre-joining formalities, document collection, offer and appointment documentation, and onboarding coordination.
* Recruitment Tracking: Maintain candidate databases, interview schedules, recruitment trackers, and regular updates on hiring progress.

**Required Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good candidate sourcing and resume-screening abilities.
* Effective interview and stakeholder coordination skills.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager - India
description:
Requisition Number: 78676
  
  
**The company built on breakthroughs.
  
  
Join us.**
Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  
  
How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
  
  
At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
  
  
Come break through with us.
  
  
Corning’s Businesses Are Ever-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
  
  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions

**Role Purpose**
The Talent Acquisition Manager - India will lead recruitment strategy and delivery across Corning India, supporting talent needs across Manufacturing, Engineering, Technology, R&D, Commercial, Corporate Functions, and Leadership hiring.
  
  
This role serves as a strategic talent partner to business leaders and HR teams, responsible for workforce planning, recruitment execution, employer branding, talent market intelligence, and recruitment operations. The incumbent will lead hiring initiatives that support business growth, manufacturing expansion, organizational transformation, and future workforce scaling while ensuring an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.
  
  
As part of Corning's Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence, the role will also contribute to regional and global talent acquisition initiatives, best practices, and continuous improvement efforts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Talent Acquisition Strategy & Business Partnership**

* Develop and execute the India Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Partner with business leaders and HR teams to forecast talent needs and build effective hiring strategies.
* Provide talent market intelligence, competitive insights, and workforce planning recommendations.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on recruitment, talent availability, and hiring best practices.

**Recruitment Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment across all functions and levels, including manufacturing, engineering, technology, R&D, commercial, corporate, and leadership hiring.
* Ensure delivery of hiring targets, service levels, and workforce commitments.
* Personally lead critical, hard-to-fill, and executive-level searches where required.
* Support large-scale hiring initiatives related to business growth, expansion projects, and organizational transformation.

**Operations & Vendor Management**

* Oversee Talent Acquisition operations, recruitment processes, and governance across India.
* Manage RPO partners, recruitment agencies, and external talent suppliers to ensure high-quality delivery.
* Monitor recruiting metrics, budget utilization, sourcing effectiveness, and hiring performance.
* Drive process improvements through the effective use of ATS, CRM, and recruitment technologies.

**Employer Branding & Talent Attraction**

* Strengthen Corning's employer brand through targeted attraction strategies and market engagement.
* Lead campus recruiting, graduate hiring, internship programs, and early-career initiatives.
* Build sustainable talent pipelines through partnerships with universities, industry associations, and talent communities.
* Collaborate with HR and Communications teams to enhance Corning's employee value proposition.

**Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain recruitment analytics, dashboards, and workforce planning metrics.
* Analyze hiring trends, sourcing performance, and recruitment effectiveness to support business decisions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on hiring quality, candidate experience, and operational efficiency.

**Projects & Transformation**

* Support talent acquisition activities related to expansion projects, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, and workforce transformation initiatives.
* Participate in regional and global TA projects, capability-building programs, and implementation of new recruiting tools and best practices.

**Experiences/Education - Required**
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree required.
* Master's Degree or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience within multinational organizations.
* Proven success leading recruitment across manufacturing, engineering, technology, commercial, corporate, and leadership functions.
* Experience managing recruitment teams, RPO providers, and agency partners.
* Strong background in workforce planning, employer branding, campus recruitment, and large-scale hiring programs.
* Exposure to regional or global recruitment environments is preferred.

**Experiences/Education - Desired**

* Strong Talent Acquisition leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term planning and operational execution.
* Expertise in workforce planning, talent analytics, and recruitment technologies.
* Strong project management, problem-solving, and change management skills.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and presentation abilities.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple business units, geographies, and stakeholders.

**Travel Requirements**

* Approximately 20-30% domestic travel within India.
* Occasional international travel as required

title: Junior HR recruiter cum Payroll executive (Export/Construction /Manufacturing / Tools/Mining Tools/Engineering)
description:
**Company Description**
HireHut Private Limited is a talent acquisition and workforce solutions company focused on helping organizations identify, attract, and hire exceptional talent. The company partners with businesses across India to provide strategic, scalable, and quality-driven recruitment solutions aligned with evolving workforce needs. Its services include permanent hiring, mid-level and specialized hiring, leadership and CXO search, bulk and volume hiring, and campus and fresher hiring. HireHut emphasizes understanding business requirements, mapping talent, conducting structured screening, and offering PAN-India candidate reach to support organizations throughout the hiring journey. With a commitment to long-term partnerships and efficient hiring cycles, HireHut enables organizations to hire with greater confidence, speed, and precision.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bhiwandi for a Junior HR Recruiter cum Payroll Executive, supporting clients in sectors such as export, construction, manufacturing, tools, mining tools, and engineering. The role involves sourcing and screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and maintaining candidate databases for various positions. The individual will assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, shortlisting, follow-ups, and onboarding support. In addition, the role includes payroll-related responsibilities such as collecting and verifying attendance data, assisting in salary processing, maintaining payroll records, and coordinating with finance and HR teams on employee compensation queries. The Junior HR Recruiter cum Payroll Executive will also support HR documentation, maintain employee records, and contribute to compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong recruitment skills, including candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and database management.
* Basic to intermediate payroll knowledge, including attendance tracking, salary processing support, and payroll documentation.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with HR or payroll software is an advantage.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Understanding of HR processes such as onboarding, documentation, and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, etc.) is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field; relevant internships or 0–2 years of experience in HR or payroll are preferred.
* Willingness to work on-site in Bhiwandi and support clients across export, construction, manufacturing, tools, mining tools, and engineering domains.

title: Manager - Human Resources
description:
